ipsum_level1.txt   shape of levels/1.txt as recorded (one address per line, no comments, no scores;
                   the real file had about 140000 lines, 2 MB);
                   the addresses are replaced by documentation addresses.
ipsum_scores.txt   made up, in the shape of the full list: comments, tab-separated score, noise.
host_errors.txt    stderr of ipset 7.19 and iptables 1.8.10 (nf_tables) recorded in a container:
                   a command that finds nothing to remove or create. Not a problem for the agent.
host_errors_real.txt  recorded stderr of real problems (in use, missing set).
